master_prompt:
Redesign the first supplied PIK brand card as a premium, exceptionally readable Persian Telegram STICKER. Image 1 provides the black charcoal background and very subtle diagonal connected-line pattern only. Image 2 is the REQUIRED current PIK logo: preserve its exact ruble-P, lowercase i, K letter shapes, white edge and restrained mint-green neon, no Exchange word. Create ONE finished square sticker, square charcoal black rounded plaque with a fine mint edge, transparent pixels OUTSIDE the rounded plaque, dark center with low-contrast diagonal pattern at the corners, understated green luminous accents. Modern clean typography, no clipart, no white margin. Logo small enough at the upper center, about 42% of the width, text is the dominant feature centered in the lower two-thirds. Persian extra-bold sans serif with correct connected letter shapes, consistent optical weight, immense legibility at 256px chat display; white first line and luminous mint second line. EXACT Persian text in TWO lines, centered, spelled exactly as follows:
اسکرین شات
مجدد لطفا
The entire phrase 'مجدد لطفا' MUST be on the SECOND line as one unbroken line. Line one must be 'اسکرین شات'. No other copy, no English subtitle, no caption, no admin handle inside the artwork. Ensure no accents or decorative artifacts touch the text. Main text comfortably inset 7% each side and at least 5% above the bottom. Make this an elegant coherent production sticker, not a poster mockup and not shown inside a phone or on a wall. Output only the sticker artwork.
first: User PIK logo and black/mint circuit background, Persian screenshot-again request on two lines; created with built-in image_gen.
